title: Pluggable Logging
requirements: `ILogger` interface; `ConsoleLogger` (colored by level), `FileLogger`, `MemoryLogger` (stores lines for tests), `NullLogger`
`MultiLogger` that forwards to several loggers (Composite pattern)
`TimestampDecorator` that wraps another logger and adds times (Decorator pattern)
Use it in an earlier project, injected via constructor
